Name: Roku - Pan Dulce
Author: rokuL4D2
Description:
The "panettone", better known as Pan Dulce, is a tradition here in Argentina. A sweet bun that must be present on any argentinian table for Christmas and New Year celebrations.

Now Gus got the recipe for it and he sells it all along the winter, so dont forget to take at least one for the Winter Star fest <3
You can buy Pan Dulce at the Star Saloon only on winter but the recipe is available for you the entire year.
You got 3 options:
-Basic Pan Dulce, which gives you luck, mining skills and defense buff.
-Pan Dulce with fruits, which make you stronger, faster and luckier.
-A "Premium" one that you should try...

... And a secret one, with a little of backstory.
